submitted.rationale: Light at 2.06 eV is below the band gap of BiVO4 (~2.4 eV), so I aimed at Cu-vanadate compositions, whose band gaps are about 1.8–2.0 eV. I focused on low-Bi compositions near Cu3V2O8. Index 56 (Bi0.08 Cu0.61 V0.32) gave the highest photocurrent of the three measurements, 1.8e-7 A.

rejected.reason: More Bi (0.15) at a similar Cu:V ratio gave a lower photocurrent, 8e-8 A
More Cu and less V (Cu:V about 2.8) gave a lower photocurrent, 5e-8 A, so Cu:V near 3:2 looks better
Its band gap is too wide to absorb 2.06 eV photons
